instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the Reporting Period dropdown is situated in the header bar identical to the Training module placement.
Hide the search input bar and the 'Add questionnaire' CTA button on the parent org ESG Questionnaire view.

Render the two-pane ESG taxonomy layout matching the reference screenshot: Left sidebar with Environment, Social, Governance categories; Right panel with Category Title breadcrumb, Action buttons, and Question Table.
Maintain all existing dialogs, edit/delete workflows, review responses panel, and supplier assignment modal logic without breaking functionality.
Add testid attributes (`data-testid`) to all interactive elements, table rows, dropdown selectors, and action buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML inputs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or dropdown overlays.
Use 2-3x generous padding inside bordered containers to avoid text clipping.
